# Markdown Kitchen Sink

A TEST FIXTURE. It is a Recommended-next target of `Guides/getting-started`, so
`test_footer_shows_multiple_next` checks for its id in the footer.

## Inline constructs

Emphasis is *single-starred*, strong is **double-starred**, and inline code is
`written in backticks`. A [link to another fixture](Guides/concepts/graph-model)
resolves through the server index.

## A fenced block

```python
def greet(name):
    return f"hello {name}"
```

## A list

- first item
- second item
- third item

1. ordered one
2. ordered two

## A table

| column | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| left | the first |
| right | the second |

## A quote

> Quoted text, which the parser lifts into a blockquote.

## Filler for scroll-spy

1280x900 viewport, and enough second-level headings to move between. That is the
only reason the sections below exist; nothing asserts their prose.
